1500: probably from εἴκω (through the idea of failure); idly, i.e. without reason (or effect):--without a cause, (in) vain(-ly).
1502: apparently a primary verb; properly, to be weak, i.e. yield:--give place.
1503: apparently a primary verb (perhaps akin to εἴκω through the idea of faintness as a copy); to resemble:--be like.
1504: from εἴκω; a likeness, i.e. (literally) statue, profile, or (figuratively) representation, resemblance:--image.
1505: from εἰλικρινής; clearness, i.e. (by implication) purity (figuratively):--sincerity.
1506: from (the sun's ray) and κρίνω; judged by sunlight, i.e. tested as genuine (figuratively):--pure, sincere.
1507: a prolonged form of a primary but defective verb (of the same meaning); to coil or wrap:--roll together. See also ἑλίσσω.
1508: from εἰ and μή; if not:--but, except (that), if not, more than, save (only) that, saving, till.
1509: from εἰ μή and the neuter of τὶς; if not somewhat:--except.
1510: the first person singular present indicative; a prolonged form of a primary and defective verb; I exist (used only when emphatic):--am, have been, X it is I, was. See also εἶ, εἴην, εἶναι, εἰσί, ἦν, ἔσομαι, ἐσμέν, ἐστέ, ἐστί, κέρδος, ἴσθι, ὦ.
1511: present infinitive from εἰμί; to exist:--am, was. come, is, X lust after, X please well, there is, to be, was.
1512: from εἰ and περ; if perhaps:--if so be (that), seeing, though.
1513: from εἰ and -πώς; if somehow:--if by any means.
1514: from εἰρήνη; to be (act) peaceful:--be at (have, live in) peace, live peaceably.
1515: probably from a primary verb (to join); peace (literally or figuratively); by implication, prosperity:--one, peace, quietness, rest, + set at one again.
1516: from εἰρήνη; pacific; by implication, salutary:--peaceable.
1517: from εἰρηνοποιός; to be a peace-maker, i.e. (figuratively) to harmonize:--make peace.
1518: from εἰρήνη and ποιέω; pacificatory, i.e. (subjectively) peaceable:--peacemaker.
1519: a primary preposition; to or into (indicating the point reached or entered), of place, time, or (figuratively) purpose (result, etc.); also in adverbial phrases:--(abundant-)ly, against, among, as, at, (back-)ward, before, by, concerning, + continual, + far more exceeding, for (intent, purpose), fore, + forth, in (among, at, unto, -so much that, -to), to the intent that, + of one mind, + never, of, (up-)on, + perish, + set at one again, (so) that, therefore(-unto), throughout, til, to (be, the end, -ward), (here-)until(-to), …ward, (where-)fore, with. Often used in composition with the same general import, but only with verbs (etc.) expressing motion (literally or figuratively).
1520: a primary numeral; one:--a(-n, -ny, certain), + abundantly, man, one (another), only, other, some. See also εἷς καθ’ εἷς, μηδείς, μία, οὐδείς.
1521: from εἰς and ἄγω; to introduce (literally or figuratively):--bring in(-to), (+ was to) lead into.
1522: from εἰς and ἀκούω; to listen to:--hear.
1523: from εἰς and δέχομαι; to take into one's favor:--receive.
1524: from εἰς and (to go); to enter:--enter (go) into.
1525: from εἰς and ἔρχομαι; to enter (literally or figuratively):--X arise, come (in, into), enter in(-to), go in (through).
1526: 3rd person plural present indicative of εἰμί; they are:--agree, are, be, dure, X is, were.
1527: from εἷς repeated with κατά inserted; severally:--one by one.
1528: from εἰς and καλέω; to invite in:--call in.
1529: from εἰς and ὁδός; an entrance (literally or figuratively):--coming, enter(-ing) in (to).
1530: from εἰς and (to leap); to rush in:--run (spring) in.
1531: from εἰς and πορεύομαι; to enter (literally or figuratively):--come (enter) in, go into.
1532: from εἰς and τρέχω; to hasten inward:--run in.
1533: from εἰς and φέρω; to carry inward (literally or figuratively):--bring (in), lead into.
1534: of uncertain affinity; a particle of succession (in time or logical enumeration), then, moreover:--after that(-ward), furthermore, then. See also ἔπειτα.
1535: from εἰ and τέ; if too:--if, or, whether.
1536: from εἰ and τὶς; if any:--he that, if a(-ny) man('s thing, from any, ought), whether any, whosoever.
1537: a primary preposition denoting origin (the point whence action or motion proceeds), from, out (of place, time, or cause; literal or figurative; direct or remote):--after, among, X are, at, betwixt(-yond), by (the means of), exceedingly, (+ abundantly above), for(- th), from (among, forth, up), + grudgingly, + heartily, X heavenly, X hereby, + very highly, in, …ly, (because, by reason) of, off (from), on, out among (from, of), over, since, X thenceforth, through, X unto, X vehemently, with(-out). Often used in composition, with the same general import; often of completion.
1538: as if a superlative of (afar); each or every:--any, both, each (one), every (man, one, woman), particularly.
1539: as if from ἕκαστος and τότε; at every time:--always.
1541: from ἑκατόν and ἔτος; centenarian:--hundred years old.
1542: from ἑκατόν and a presumed derivative of πλάσσω; a hundred times:--hundredfold.
1543: from ἑκατόν and ἄρχω; the captain of one hundred men:--centurion.
1544: from ἐκ and βάλλω; to eject (literally or figuratively):--bring forth, cast (forth, out), drive (out), expel, leave, pluck (pull, take, thrust) out, put forth (out), send away (forth, out).
1545: from a compound of ἐκ and the base of βάσις (meaning to go out); an exit (literally or figuratively):--end, way to escape.
1546: from ἐκβάλλω; ejection, i.e. (specially) a throwing overboard of the cargo:--+ lighten the ship.
1547: from ἐκ and a form of γαμίσκω (compare ἐκγαμίσκω); to marry off a daughter:--give in marriage.
1548: from ἐκ and γαμίσκω; the same as 1547:--give in marriage.
1549: neuter of a derivative of a compound of ἐκ and γίνομαι; a descendant, i.e. (specially) grandchild:--nephew.
1550: from ἐκ and δαπανάω; to expend (wholly), i.e. (figuratively) exhaust:--spend.
1551: from ἐκ and δέχομαι; to accept from some source, i.e. (by implication) to await:--expect, look (tarry) for, wait (for).
1552: from ἐκ and δῆλος; wholly evident:--manifest.
1553: from a compound of ἐκ and δῆμος; to emigrate, i.e. (figuratively) vacate or quit:--be absent.
1554: from ἐκ and δίδωμι; to give forth, i.e. (specially) to lease:--let forth (out).
1555: from ἐκ and a compound of διά and ἡγέομαι; to narrate through wholly:--declare.
1556: from ἔκδικος; to vindicate, retaliate, punish:--a (re-)venge.
1557: from ἐκδικέω; vindication, retribution:--(a-, re-)venge(-ance), punishment.
1558: from ἐκ and δίκη; carrying justice out, i.e. a punisher:--a (re-)venger.
1559: from ἐκ and διώκω; to pursue out, i.e. expel or persecute implacably:--persecute.
1560: from ἐκ and a derivative of δίδωμι; given out or over, i.e. surrendered:--delivered.
1562: from ἐκ and the base of δύνω; to cause to sink out of, i.e. (specially as of clothing) to divest:--strip, take off from, unclothe.
1563: of uncertain affinity; there; by extension, thither:--there, thither(-ward), (to) yonder (place).
1564: from ἐκεῖ; thence:--from that place, (from) thence, there.
1565: from ἐκεῖ; that one (or (neuter) thing); often intensified by the article prefixed:--he, it, the other (same), selfsame, that (same, very), X their, X them, they, this, those. See also οὗτος.
1567: from ἐκ and ζητέω; to search out, i.e. (figuratively)investigate, crave, demand, (by Hebraism) worship:--en- (re-)quire, seek after (carefully, diligently).
1568: from ἔκθαμβος; to astonish utterly:--affright, greatly (sore) amaze.
1569: from ἐκ and θάμβος; utterly astounded:--greatly wondering.
1570: from ἐκ and a derivative of τίθημι; put out, i.e. exposed to perish:--cast out.
1571: from ἐκ and καθαίρω; to cleanse thoroughly:--purge (out).
1572: from ἐκ and καίω; to inflame deeply:--burn.
1573: from ἐκ and κακός; to be (bad or) weak, i.e. (by implication) to fail (in heart):--faint, be weary.
1574: from ἐκ and the base of κέντρον; to transfix:--pierce.
1575: from ἐκ and κλάω; to exscind:--break off.
1576: from ἐκ and κλείω; to shut out (literally or figuratively):--exclude.
1577: from a compound of ἐκ and a derivative of καλέω; a calling out, i.e. (concretely) a popular meeting, especially a religious congregation (Jewish synagogue, or Christian community of members on earth or saints in heaven or both):--assembly, church.
1578: from ἐκ and κλίνω; to deviate, i.e. (absolutely) to shun (literally or figuratively), or (relatively) to decline (from piety):--avoid, eschew, go out of the way.
1579: from ἐκ and κολυμβάω; to escape by swimming:--swim out.
1580: from ἐκ and κομίζω; to bear forth (to burial):--carry out.
1581: from ἐκ and κόπτω; to exscind; figuratively, to frustrate:--cut down (off, out), hew down, hinder.
1582: middle voice from ἐκ and κρεμάννυμι; to hang upon the lips of a speaker, i.e. listen closely:--be very attentive.
1583: from ἐκ and λαλέω; to divulge:--tell.
1584: from ἐκ and λάμπω; to be resplendent:--shine forth.
1585: middle voice from ἐκ and λανθάνω; to be utterly oblivious of:--forget.
1586: middle voice from ἐκ and λέγω (in its primary sense); to select:--make choice, choose (out), chosen.
1587: from ἐκ and λείπω; to omit, i.e. (by implication) cease (die):--fail.
1588: from ἐκλέγομαι; select; by implication, favorite:--chosen, elect.
1589: from ἐκλέγομαι; (divine) selection (abstractly or concretely):--chosen, election.
1590: from ἐκ and λύω; to relax (literally or figuratively):--faint.
1591: from ἐκ and the base of μασσάομαι; to knead out, i.e. (by analogy) to wipe dry:--wipe.
1592: from ἐκ and μυκτηρίζω; to sneer outright at:--deride.
1593: from ἐκ and νεύω; (by analogy) to slip off, i.e. quietly withdraw:--convey self away.
1594: from ἐκ and νήφω; (figuratively) to rouse (oneself) out of stupor:--awake.
1595: neuter of a derivative from ἑκών; voluntariness:--willingly.
1596: adverb from the same as ἑκούσιον; voluntarily:--wilfully, willingly.
1597: from ἐκ and πάλαι; long ago, for a long while:--of a long time, of old.
1598: from ἐκ and πειράζω; to test thoroughly:--tempt.
1599: from ἐκ and πέμπω; to despatch:--send away (forth).
